summary: The feed's quiet check, ping, pong wait and retry delays can be capped with STUI_FEED_TIMER_CAP_MS, which only the end-to-end tests set, like STUI_OFFLINE_GRACE_MS. The daemon-less stui pairing test sets 2 s and takes about 21 s instead of about 37 s, most of which was waiting 20 s to drop a silent link.

replay.detail: No claim, replay or projection change.

rules.detail: No rule, permission or trust change.

compatibility.detail: No wire, CLI or client change: unset, every timer keeps its value.

downtime.detail: Nothing runs differently on installed machines.

recovery.detail: Revert the commit; the test then waits out the default timers again.
